preconditions.description: The length of the hexadecimal string S must be at most 14.
At least one character in the hexadecimal string S must be non-zero.

postconditions.description: If it is not possible to find a valid original string, output 'NO'.
The output must be a lowercase hexadecimal string with leading zeros to match the length of S.
The sum of the output and S must equal the numerical value of the sorted version of S.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"len(S) <= 14","description":"The length of the hexadecimal string S must be at most 14."},{"id":"P2","expression":"any(c != '0' for c in S)","description":"At least one character in the hexadecimal string S must be non-zero."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == 'NO'","description":"If it is not possible to find a valid original string, output 'NO'."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout.startswith('0') and len(stdout) == len(S)","description":"The output must be a lowercase hexadecimal string with leading zeros to match the length of S."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"int(stdout, 16) + int(S, 16) == int(''.join(sorted(S)), 16)","description":"The sum of the output and S must equal the numerical value of the sorted version of S."}],"invariants":[]}
